channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Is Cyprus safe to travel to? UK issues new advice for Brits amid Middle East attacks
item.description: See if it's safe to travel to Cyprus from the UK as Foreign Office issues new advice amid Middle East war and HMS Dragon enroute - TUI flights cancelled

item.title: Rare Royal Mint coin sells for 500 times face value because of the Queen's head
item.description: The item is mis-struck, meaning it was incorrectly imprinted while being minted, and so the image of Queen Elizabeth II's head appears upside down

item.title: 'Don't risk it' government issues travel warning to all Brits who have a passport
item.description: All Brits who have a passport are being warned to protect it and their identity by His Majesty's Passport Office.

item.title: Woman's 'inhuman' death in Ysbyty Glan Clwyd corridor 'should haunt Welsh Government'
item.description: An elderly woman's "lonely" death in an Ysbyty Glan Clwyd corridor "should haunt the Welsh Government", a politician has said.

item.title: ‘No one should die like this’: Woman’s final moments in North Wales hospital corridor
item.description: A witness says she is “haunted” after seeing an elderly woman die alone in a corridor at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd’s overcrowded A&E, raising fresh concerns about dignity, delays, and the pressures facing frontline staff.

item.title: Two special guests join TK Maxx presents Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2026 line-up
item.description: Two new artists have been added to the TK Maxx presents Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2026 line-up.

item.title: From Conwy to global spotlight with Wrexham AFC: Maxine Hughes’ inspiring journey
item.description: Maxine Hughes became a globally recognised Welsh voice through Welcome to Wrexham, her work with Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney bringing her from Conwy to screens around the world - she speaks candidly about her diagnosis with triple‑negative breast cancer in a new S4C interview airing mid‑March, timed to coincide with International Women’s Day and Mother’s Day.

item.title: UK Government advises do not travel unless ‘essential’ to holiday spot in new update
item.description: The UK Government has advised against all but essential travel to Thailand in the latest Foreign Office travel update, citing the escalation in the Middle East.

item.title: Car park cash clash between councils puts Beaumaris museums and jobs on the line
item.description: Beaumaris leaders warn that losing control of a key car park could force the closure of two historic museums and put six jobs at risk, after Anglesey County Council rejected a bid to keep the site under town management.

item.title: Former North Wales police commissioner candidate arrested in China spying inquiry
item.description: Ruthin-born former PCC candidate David Taylor, husband of Labour MP Joani Reid, has been arrested on suspicion of spying for China as counter‑terrorism officers investigate alleged foreign interference in UK democracy.
